proportion_tests.title: Subscription vs Non-Subscription Repeat Purchase Rate (Mature Buyers)
proportion_tests.causal_caveat: Strong selection bias exists: customers with ongoing chronic refill needs self-select into subscriptions. Observational parity proves association, not causal lift; run a randomized subscription-nudge holdout to measure causal incremental retention.

proportion_tests.title: Native App vs Mobile Web Cart-to-Checkout Progression Rate
proportion_tests.causal_caveat: Partly reflects user intent mix (returning refillers skew toward Native App while paid/social new visitors skew toward Mobile Web), combined with Mobile Web authentication and checkout UX friction. Validate UX fixes via A/B test on Mobile Web checkout.

proportion_tests.title: Q2 2026 Cohorts (Apr–Jun) vs Baseline (Oct–Feb) Month-1 Retention
proportion_tests.causal_caveat: Coincides with aggressive Q2 Social Media (SPRINGBLITZ) and Affiliate (AFFILFLASH) 22–25% discount acquisition campaigns that shifted channel mix toward promo-sensitive one-time buyers.

proportion_tests.title: Tier 3 Cities (Lucknow, Indore) vs Tier 1 Cities Order Cancellation Rate
proportion_tests.causal_caveat: Driven by longer promised and actual delivery SLAs (4+ days), higher Cash-on-Delivery share, and monsoon transit bottlenecks rather than city demand alone.

proportion_tests.title: Chronic Refill Categories vs Non-Chronic First-Order Repeat Rate
proportion_tests.causal_caveat: Reflects intrinsic replenishment frequency of ongoing healthcare needs versus episodic acute purchases.
